messages:
mira: quick check — I'm rolling a terraform change that moves the IRSA annotation from each ServiceAccount to the namespace (trying to avoid per-SA patches). terraform plan looks fine but pods fail with token not projected. Anyone hit this? Example snippet:
```
# terraform k8s resource earlier
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "svc" {
  metadata {
    name = "worker"
    namespace = var.ns
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.svc.arn
    }
  }
}
# tentative change: apply annotation to namespace.metadata.annotations
```

mira: error from pod: "failed to retrieve token: projected service account token not found" when starting sidecar.

jason: :eyes: AWS IRSA only reads annotation on the service account, not the namespace. Moving it to namespace won't work. We tried that for bulk-annotation but it breaks the OIDC webhook flow.

sam: confirm. The webhook maps SA -> IAM role by reading annotation on the SA. Namespace-level annotation is ignored. You can mass-patch SAs with a script or use a helper in helm values.serviceAccount.annotations.

anya: if you want central control, consider a mutating webhook that injects annotation into created SAs, or use kustomize/helm to set SA template. Example kustomize patch:
```
patches:
- target:
    kind: ServiceAccount
  patch: |-
    - op: add
      path: /metadata/annotations/eks.amazonaws.com~1role-arn
      value: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/...
```

platform-bot: deployment checks: @mira please ensure terraform plan doesn't remove SA annotation before a replacer applies patch. Otherwise there's a small window where pods restart and fail authentication.

jason: Also note projected token TTLs. If you rely on projected tokens for kube2iam fallback, ensure BoundServiceAccountTokenVolume feature is enabled in your cluster and webhook configuration hasn't been updated to disable token issuance.

mira: looks like our Terraform module was assuming namespace annotation works. I'll revert the namespace change and open a PR to mass-patch existing SAs.

sam: for mass patch, simple kubectl one-liner:
```
kubectl -n $NS get sa -o name | xargs -n1 -I{} kubectl annotate {} eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn=arn:aws:iam::123456:role/team-worker --overwrite
```

sam: or with jq for terraform-import friendly flow to avoid drift if you prefer to keep things in code.

anya: also add a CI lint step to check terraform templates that remove SA annotations. I can add a policy in our pre-merge checks (tfsec or a small tflint rule).

mira: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll push the revert PR and ping when plan is clean.

deploy-bot: prod deploy scheduled for 2026-04-05 08:00 UTC (no changes until PR merged) :lock:
